How to organize research with visual pins

By Dana Lee, product designer

Start with one board per question

Research gets messy when every link lands in one long list. Instead, create one board for each question you are trying to answer, and pin sources to the board as you find them. A board titled "Which onboarding flows convert best?" is easier to reason about than a folder called "misc links".

Tag as you go

Tags are cheap to add and expensive to add later. Add two or three tags when you pin something: the source type, the topic, and how much you trust it.

Suggested tags

  • source:paper
  • source:blog
  • trust:high
